name: multi-vendor-spike
description: Multi-vendor latency + voice quality spike: STT/LLM/TTS/memory/transport swappable. Compares head-to-head with the xAI single-vendor baseline. Goal: < 1.0s first-audio, Eve-class voice quality, $20-50/mo cost.
